# authwise_scope (Resource)

An OAuth scope on an audience, and the access permissions it grants. The id is the scope's own name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, which the server composes from the parent and this id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Parent identifier `audience_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `auto` (Boolean)
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `kind` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
# The id is the scope's own name, which you choose.
terraform import authwise_scope.example tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01/audiences/a-01/scopes/read.users
```
